original_call.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished reveal illustration for a warm hand-drawn 2D nonogram collection. Generate ONE single detailed full-color claw hammer, isolated on a truly transparent PNG background, portrait canvas roughly 2:3. A beautiful carefully drawn everyday tool, clear confident dark brown contours, filled coherent rich colors, restrained soft shading and material details; polished illustrated album aesthetic, not photorealistic, not 3D, not pixel art, not a silhouette. Complete hammer visible with comfortable transparent margin. Essential anatomy: one steel head with a circular flat striking face at one end and a smoothly backward-curving nail-pulling split claw at the other end; clearly visible open V-shaped notch between TWO claw prongs. Long handle connected naturally below middle of head. Favour a readable near-side view with just enough three-quarter depth to see striking face and split claw. One hammer only. No nails, hands, scene, table, cast shadow, backdrop, grid, text, letters, branding, watermark or decorative objects. Main silhouette must remain distinguishable when later abstracted into a very small 10 cells wide by 15 cells tall MONOCHROME puzzle, but this image must be a detailed full-color finished illustration, never a grid or coarse pixel drawing. Preserve genuinely transparent outside and the claw notch, preserve light steel highlights as opaque material. Variant A: classic traditional hammer almost upright, long honey-amber hickory handle tapering subtly and flaring gently at lower end, elegant wood grain. Compact satin cool silver steel head across the top, striking face on viewer's LEFT, claw on RIGHT curling downward with a clear broad V separation visible. Head occupies approximately 70% of canvas width, handle and head occupy 84% of height. Slight three-quarter side angle, calm balanced composition. Warm wood and cool blue-grey steel with bright controlled highlights, gently used surface.
